about_the_game:
Content Warning:
Signal Lost is a single-player psychological horror experience designed to create sustained fear and tension. Players will encounter sudden jump scares, unsettling audio transmissions, and an unseen hostile presence. The game includes moments of implied physical harm, intense pursuit sequences, and occasional stylized blood within environmental storytelling.

While no explicit gore or sexual content is present, the atmosphere, sound design, and visual tone may be disturbing to sensitive players. Headphones are strongly recommended for full immersion.

Signal Lost: The Silence Between Words is a minimalist psychological horror experience set entirely within an abandoned, underground relay room.

You awaken in silence. The only object in the room—a military radio—whispers fragments of corrupted transmissions. Voices from the past. Numbers. Static. Something unintelligible…

As you tune the dial, you begin to uncover strange patterns, eerie broadcasts, and encrypted messages. But you're not alone. The more frequencies you unlock, the more it becomes aware of you.

The words themselves begin to vanish. Meaning breaks down. The room responds.

Can you find the right signal before language—and your sanity—disappears for good?

📡 Features

  • 📻 One Room. Endless Signals.
    Explore narrative depth and horror within a confined, claustrophobic space.

  • 📡 Interactive Radio-Tuning Mechanic
    Uncover messages, clues, and trigger events by tuning into the right frequencies.

  • 🧠 Psychological Pressure System
    Your actions awaken the presence in the room—every discovery increases risk.

  • 📖 Audio-Based Lore Discovery
    Voice logs, distorted memories, and transmissions tell a fragmented story.

  • 🔁 Multiple Endings
    Choose the wrong frequency and pay the price. Or silence it all—permanently.

  • ⏱️ Built for Short Sessions
    Designed for 30–60 minute playthroughs with high replay value.

📡 Wishlist now.

Some signals are better left unheard.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent scenes of psychological horror, intense jump scares, and sustained tension. It also includes depictions of violence, implied harm, and occasional stylized blood. Player discretion is advised.

short_description: Tune the radio. Silence the voices. Escape the dark. Signal Lost is a psychological horror experience where every sound matters. Lost in an abandoned underground relay station, your only link to reality is the static between transmissions.
